steam.patches: MetaAudio (github.com/LAGonauta/MetaAudio, needs MetaHookSv) adds EAX/A3D-style reverb and HRTF to the current Steam build.

eax.problem: The original release used DirectSound3D, but a 2013 update replaced it with a newer audio engine that dropped EAX entirely.
eax.fix: If you still have the pre-2013 retail release, point this script at that install instead — EAX still works there.
